This is the AML watchlist + adverse-media screening endpoint, DISTINCT from /v3/database-validation (database identity validation). Don't confuse the two — /v3/aml screens a name against global sanctions/PEP/adverse-media datasets.
Response can be very large (~476KB for a common name like 'John Smith' = 86 hits). Page or filter body.aml.hits[] by .match==true or .match_score/.risk_score rather than dumping the whole array.
A name with many hits returns status 'In Review' (not an error) — read body.aml.total_hits and inspect hits[] for actual matches; review_status per hit is 'Unreviewed' by default.
usage.guide: Send a POST to https://x402.orth.sh/didit/v3/aml with a JSON body {"full_name": "<person or company name>"}. Pay $0.36 USDC on Base via x402 (no API key). The call returns HTTP 200 with body.aml.status, body.aml.total_hits, and body.aml.hits[] — an array of sanctions/PEP/adverse-media watchlist matches. Read body.aml.total_hits to gauge volume and iterate body.aml.hits[] checking .match, .match_score, and .risk_score per hit; the response can be hundreds of KB for common names so filter rather than process everything. Note: full_name is the ONLY required field — first_name/last_name will 400.
